sessionStart.bash:
d="$HOME/.copilot/gated-change-hook-probe"; mkdir -p "$d" 2>/dev/null; p=$(cat); n=$(env | grep -E "^[A-Z_]*(COPILOT|PLUGIN|CLAUDE)" | cut -d= -f1 | tr "
" ","); printf "%s	%s	%s	%s	%s
" "$GC_PROBE_EVENT" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$PWD" "$n" "$(printf "%s" "$p" | tr "
	" "  ")" >> "$d/events.tsv" 2>/dev/null; exit 0
sessionStart.powershell: $ErrorActionPreference='SilentlyContinue'; try { $p=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); $d=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.copilot\gated-change-hook-probe'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $d | Out-Null; $names=(Get-ChildItem env: | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'COPILOT|PLUGIN|CLAUDE' } | ForEach-Object { $_.Name }) -join ','; $vars=[ordered]@{}; foreach($n in 'PLUGIN_ROOT','PLUGIN_DATA','COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT','CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT','COPILOT_HOME'){ $v=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($n); if($v){ $vars[$n]=$v } }; $rec=[ordered]@{ event=$env:GC_PROBE_EVENT; at=(Get-Date).ToString('o'); cwd=(Get-Location).Path; envNames=$names; pluginVars=$vars; payload=$p }; Add-Content -Encoding UTF8 -Path (Join-Path $d 'events.jsonl') -Value ($rec | ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 5) } catch {}; exit 0
